keyFindings.description: The merge of this PR into current main times out internal/dispatch/docs under envoy-go-race's -timeout 30m, twice in a row (1801.0 s, 1800.9 s). Main alone already uses 1742-1760 s of the 1800 s; this PR's added docs tests carry the merged package past it. Once merged, the lane goes red on main and on every branch. Make the merged package fit: shorten this PR's slowest docs tests (real waits, 30 s awaits, backdating loops), or give internal/dispatch/docs a race step of its own with a timeout and job timeout-minutes that fit it, keeping the 'timeout fires before the job is cancelled' rule the job comment states. Prove it with a green envoy-go-race at the new head.

reportedOutside: Main's own margin (1742-1760 s of 1800 s) was sent to the INFRA controller with the run ids at 19:50 UTC.
